slides.text: You're awake early, sweetie! Well, I knew you wouldn't sleep much on this day! You finally get to live your dreams, and I couldn't be more proud no matter what you decide to do!
I'm sure you'll be among the best duelists in the world! Anyway, I'm sure you can't wait any longer, so grab your breakfast and go see Mr. Moto at his shop!
He'll hand you your permit and your first deck. Aah, I remember what that feeling was like for me.
Alright, now I won't keep you any longer. Give me a hug and I'll let you go!
